description: This PHP source file defines the 'Jjwg_MapsViewConfig' class, a view component for configuring map-related settings within a SuiteCRM module. It contains methods for displaying a comprehensive configuration form with various fields, dropdowns, and settings related to Google Maps API, geocoding modules, address types, marker grouping, and other map parameters.

classes.name: Jjwg_MapsViewConfig
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to render the module's configuration interface for map settings.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the configuration form with various map settings, API keys, address types, marker grouping, geocoding options, cache settings, and map display parameters.
